claims.content: To analyze auction business performance through site metrics, merchandising/inventory, and sales reporting.

goal.raw_text: To analyze auction business performance through site metrics, merchandising/inventory, and sales reporting.

claims.content: Business Owner
The system must provide access to the 'Customer Ranking Report' functionality, which is intended to illustrate customer behavior within various categories.

The Business Owner must be able to specify selection criteria for the report, including Date Range (start date and end date), Product Type, Gemstone Type, Retail Category, and Auction Duration or Event Profile.

The Business Owner initiates the analysis by selecting a specific report type (e.g., Customer Ranking Report, Auctions RFM Report, or Inventory Performance & Aging Report) to understand business performance metrics.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner initiates the analysis by selecting a specific report type (e.g., Customer Ranking Report, Auctions RFM Report, or Inventory Performance & Aging Report) to understand business performance metrics.

claims.content: The Business Owner accesses the Auction Administration ('AA') application via the 'Main Menu' page.
The Business Owner selects a specific report type from the available capabilities, such as creating/viewing sales & churn reports, customer activity reports, or inventory performance reports.

If the RFM Report is selected, the system displays Recency, Frequency, and Monetary sections with tiers split into six time ranges (0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, and over 365 days).
The user chooses the timeframe for the report via radio buttons, selecting either a 'lifetime' report using all available sales data or limiting the report to only the past 12 months.
The system calculates and displays fields including revenue per account, orders per account, and % of total accounts within each tier.
The final row provides the total for each column in the report.
If the Inventory Performance & Aging Report is selected, the system presents a mockup interface allowing selection of auction houses, date ranges, and filtering options.
The system generates the report showing inventory metrics including SKU details, aging categories, and summary statistics based on selected criteria.

If the Business Owner selects the Customer Ranking Report, they can specify criteria including Date Range, Product Type, Gemstone Type, Retail Category, and Auction Duration or Event Profile to analyze customer behavior.

The system includes the customer's email address in the Customer Ranking Report output so that a 'special offer' mailing could be generated quickly if certain criteria result in a high-probability conversion customer list.
The Business Owner may choose to export the Customer Ranking Report to Excel or copy-and-paste it to Excel for further analysis, sorting, and filtering to identify worst customers.
When generating the RFM Report, the Monetary and Frequency sections use the same data columns as the Recency section, with tiers displayed consistently across all three sections.
If the Inventory Performance & Aging Report is selected, the system allows filtering by auction house, date range, item status (e.g., ‘Items with Bids’, ‘Items Won’), and location-based criteria.

The Business Owner has successfully viewed a report (Customer Ranking, RFM, or Inventory Performance & Aging) that illustrates business performance metrics such as customer behavior, spending trends, or inventory aging.

If the Customer Ranking Report was generated, the output includes columns for Customer’s Member ID ('Handle'), Email Address, New or Long-Term status, Total Items Bid On, Total Bids Placed, Gross Items Won, Gross Winnings, Average Price Point, Cancelled Orders, Cancel Rate (Units), Cancel Order Value, Cancel Rate ($$), Total Items Returned, Total $$ Returned, Net Kept Winnings, and Net Kept Units.

If the RFM Report was generated, the Recency section is split into six tiers: 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, and over 365 days, with calculated fields including revenue per account, orders per account, and % of total accounts within each tier.
The final row of the RFM Report provides the total for each column, summarizing aggregate performance across all tiers.

If the Inventory Performance & Aging Report was generated, the system displays SKU-level details, aging categories, and summary statistics based on selected filters such as auction house, date range, and item status.

The Business Owner has the option to export any generated report to Excel or copy-and-paste it into Excel for further analysis, sorting, and filtering — particularly to identify worst-performing customers or underperforming inventory.
